subject: Sunbridge: custom metrics & audit delivery — prioritization ask
messages:
From: laura_bennett
To: aditya_rao, karthik_iyer, jasmine_liu
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@sunbridge.com>
Date: 2026-07-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sunbridge: custom metrics & audit delivery — prioritization ask

Team,

Quick context: Sunbridge is asking us to ship a small set of customer-specific telemetry exports and enhanced audit records as part of their renewal negotiation. This is tied directly to the commitment in the MAP (attached) — if we can deliver a light-weight export they will sign a 24-month committed contract with a 30% ARR uplift.

What they need (high-level):
- Time-series export of per-tenant inference latency and token-cost metrics (CSV or S3 sink)
- Per-request audit record with routing/variant decision tags for a 90-day retention window
- Simple dashboard or API for their security team to query aggregated metrics weekly

Constraints: they want a production-ready, low-risk change and prefer phased delivery. Sales asks we treat this as a priority to hit the renewal window in Q3.

Ask for Product/Eng: can we scope this into a small deliverable (2–3 weeks) as an export shim or does it require a deeper telemetry pipeline change (4–8+ weeks)? Please call out risk, infra impact, and any licensing/pricing implications.

I’ve attached the MAP and scheduled a brief sync (TBD) — would like a go/no-go by EOD Thursday so we can commit to the renewal timeline.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Sunbridge-MAP.pdf (summary)
From: jasmine_liu
To: laura_bennett, aditya_rao, karthik_iyer
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@sunbridge.com>, Natalie Rees <natalie.rees@sunbridge.com>
Date: 2026-07-07T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sunbridge: custom metrics & audit delivery — prioritization ask

Laura — adding a few clarifications from the CS side (copied the Sunbridge contacts):

Thanks for the context. A couple items customer-side that matter for scope:
- Export format: they prefer daily CSV drop to an S3 bucket they control (not pushing into their internal telemetry stack)
- Audit granularity: per-request record with request-id, model-variant, route, timestamp, and token counts. They want these records searchable for compliance queries but do not require real-time indexing.
- Auth: they will consume via pre-signed S3 URLs; we do not need to implement additional auth flows.

Phasing suggestion (from CS):
1) Phase 1 (MVP, 2 weeks): export shim that writes compressed CSVs to customer S3 with the necessary fields + 90-day retention controls on our side. No change to routing logic.
2) Phase 2 (optional, 4–8 weeks): integrate with telemetry pipeline to support queries/dashboards and reduce export cost for high-volume tenants.

Attached is a spreadsheet with the field spec they shared. If Product/Eng can confirm Phase 1 feasibility we’ll push the renewal forward.

—Jasmine
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sunbridge-metrics-specs.xlsx
From: aditya_rao
To: laura_bennett, jasmine_liu
Cc: karthik_iyer
Date: 2026-07-08T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sunbridge: custom metrics & audit delivery — prioritization ask

Thanks — good summary. A few quick thoughts and options for prioritization:

Option A (fast, low-risk) — Export shim (2 weeks):
- Build a lightweight, configurable exporter that emits compressed CSVs to S3 on a daily cadence.
- Minimal changes to runtime: hook into existing post-request pipeline, write an async job to batch and upload.
- Low infra/ops impact; can be gated per-tenant.

Option B (medium effort) — Telemetry integration (6 weeks):
- Pipe structured events into telemetry infra, add a queryable API and dashboard.
- Better long-term UX and cost, but requires infra work and schema changes.

Open questions for Sales/CS to help prioritize:
- Is the ARR uplift documented and gated on delivery? (Laura: you flagged 30% uplift in your note.)
- Are there any legal/compliance constraints beyond 90-day retention?

If the revenue impact exists and legal is okay, we can probably carve an initial 2-week spike to validate Option A and then schedule the broader integration in a patch cycle. Karthik — can you speak to sprint availability and risk?

Aditya
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer
To: aditya_rao, laura_bennett, jasmine_liu
Date: 2026-07-08T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sunbridge: custom metrics & audit delivery — prioritization ask

On Thu, Jul 8, 2026 at 08:30 AM aditya_rao wrote:
> If the revenue impact exists and legal is okay, we can probably carve an initial 2-week spike to validate Option A and then schedule the broader integration in a patch cycle. Karthik — can you speak to sprint availability and risk?

We can do Option A as a targeted spike. Quick feasibility notes:
- ETA: 10–14 dev work days for a single engineer + 2 days QA if we scope it narrowly (export shim + config + S3 uploader + basic retries).
- Risks: must ensure we don’t expose internal PII in CSVs. CS/Legal should confirm allowed fields. Also need a canary to ensure high-volume tenants don’t overload the uploader — propose throttling at the uploader layer and per-tenant rate limit.
- Infra impact: modest; we can run the uploader as a consumer in the existing async workers for now.
- Backfill / replays: not included in Phase 1; would be Phase 2 work.

I’ll draft an RFC for the shim and include a fallback plan — attaching a quick RFC. If Product wants this prioritized, we need a decision to reserve a sprint slot and confirmation from Legal on allowed fields.

Karthik
Staff Engineer, Inference Runtime

Attachments: RFC-export-shim.md
From: laura_bennett
To: aditya_rao, karthik_iyer, jasmine_liu
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@sunbridge.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sunbridge: custom metrics & audit delivery — prioritization ask

Thanks everyone — based on the timeline and risk notes we’ll proceed with Option A (export shim) and push the MAP milestone to next week.

Next steps I’ll own:
- Confirm the 30% ARR uplift in the contract (done) and notify contracts@sunbridge.com to prepare updated SOW.
- Work with Legal to confirm allowed audit fields (ETA: EOD Monday).

Product/Eng asks: please confirm sprint reservation for a single engineer (10 dev days + 2 QA) and send a short implementation checklist by EOD Monday so CS can set expectations with Sunbridge.

Laura
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
